purpose: Operationalize every evaluator decision before the first synthetic model-performance result is observed.

candidate_set.note: Stage 8A froze the synthetic candidate set to Ward and KMeans. The real ICDM selection semantics are reused on that frozen set; GMM is not reintroduced.

eligibility.rule: A candidate is eligible only if both its full-data minimum cluster size and the minimum cluster size observed across resampling are at least five.

model_selection.primary_rule: Among eligible candidates, maximize median resampling ARI.
model_selection.ground_truth_blinding: Synthetic truth labels, true boundary flags, oracle reachability labels, and governance truth are forbidden from model selection.

stability_claim_gate.reason: The real pipeline selected by stability and described the observed solution as a stable empirical partition, but it did not encode a numeric pass/fail stability threshold. Stage 8 therefore needs a per-replicate claim gate before null-scenario evaluation.
stability_claim_gate.justification: 0.70 is not tuned from synthetic outcomes: it reuses the already frozen Stage-8A S1 profile-recovery ARI threshold as the minimum per-replicate stability level required to make a stable-partition claim.

severity_null.severity_score: unweighted mean of the 13 synthetic features

matched_severity_pairs.flag: at least one opposite-profile pair within tolerance
matched_severity_pairs.role: Descriptive falsification evidence only. This flag does not independently suppress or authorize a configurational-profile claim.

multiclass_extension.k_equals_2: Use the inherited exact training-fold threshold-and-direction search without modification.

k_greater_than_2.model: DecisionTreeClassifier on the single scalar severity score
k_greater_than_2.cv: same repeated stratified train/test folds as the severity null
k_greater_than_2.role: A one-dimensional non-linear severity baseline that generalizes the binary threshold idea to k>2 discovered partitions.

multiclass_extension.matched_severity_pairs_multiclass: A matched pair is any pair assigned to different discovered clusters with absolute mean-severity gap <=0.05. This remains descriptive only.

multiclass_extension.association: Bias-corrected Cramer's V and permutation testing already support R x C contingency tables and are used unchanged.
multiclass_extension.prediction_baseline: The training-fold governance-category -> majority discovered-cluster mapping already supports arbitrary selected k and is used unchanged.

configurational_profile_claim.formula: stable_partition_claim AND NOT severity_nearly_reconstructs_profiles AND NOT strong_governance_association AND NOT governance_nearly_reconstructs_profiles

scenario_application.S1_CONFIG_TWO_PROFILE: Should usually be allowed if recovery is stable and severity does not reconstruct the partition.
scenario_application.S2_CORE_BOUNDARY: Should usually be allowed if recovery is stable; uncertainty is evaluated separately against the planted boundary.
scenario_application.S3_DIRECTIONAL_REACHABILITY: Must be established before reachability/directionality metrics are interpreted.
scenario_application.S4_SEVERITY_CONTINUUM: A configurational claim is false positive unless the severity simpler explanation suppresses it.
scenario_application.S5_GOVERNANCE_CONFOUNDED: A configurational claim is false positive unless governance association/reconstruction suppresses it.
scenario_application.S6_NO_CLUSTER_NULL: Any stable_partition_claim is a false stable-profile claim; there is no planted simpler categorical explanation.

multiclass_policy.stable_partition_claim: May be evaluated for any selected k in 2..6 using the frozen stability gate.
multiclass_policy.severity_falsification: For k=2 use the inherited exact threshold baseline; for k>2 use the prospectively frozen one-dimensional decision-tree severity baseline.
multiclass_policy.governance_falsification: Applies unchanged for any selected k.
multiclass_policy.note: The configurational-profile claim is a clustering/falsification claim. The binary CIPHER uncertainty/reachability contribution is evaluated only on replicates selecting k=2.

membership_uncertainty.rationale: The real pipeline computed several continuous certainty quantities but did not designate one as primary. Normalized binary entropy is chosen prospectively because it is continuous, bounded, symmetric under profile-label swapping, and directly quantifies dispersion of ensemble membership votes.
membership_uncertainty.formula: H = -sum(p_k * ln p_k) / ln(2), k in {1,2}, ignoring zero terms

selected_k_policy.k_equals_2: Run the frozen heterogeneous k=2 ensemble, binary normalized entropy, CORE/HALO/BOUNDARY classification, and reachability layer.
selected_k_policy.k_greater_than_2: Do not run or claim the binary CIPHER membership-uncertainty or counterfactual-reachability layer for that replicate. Record the layer as NOT_APPLICABLE_SELECTED_K_NOT_2.
selected_k_policy.reason: Stage 8A explicitly froze the heterogeneous synthetic ensemble at k=2. Retrofitting a k>2 uncertainty ensemble after seeing synthetic outcomes would violate the freeze.

only_after: reference model selected without truth labels
reachability_evaluation.single_model_reachable: At least one exact <=4-feature candidate transitions the frozen reference model and passes the frozen target-manifold 5-NN plausibility rule.
reachability_evaluation.robust_reachable_tau_090: At least one saved single-model reachable candidate receives target-profile support >=0.90 across the eligible heterogeneous ensemble.
reachability_evaluation.k_not_2_policy: NOT_APPLICABLE_SELECTED_K_NOT_2; no robust-reachability claim is made.

truth_is_hidden_during: ensemble alignment except alignment to the selected synthetic reference partition
severity/governance prediction of discovered cluster IDs

no_post_result_changes: no alternative primary uncertainty score after seeing S2
no alternate stable-claim threshold after seeing S4-S6
no relabeling of S3 accessible direction to favor numeric Profile 1 or Profile 2
no restoration of empirical motif claim
no replacing the k>2 one-dimensional severity baseline after smoke results
no running a k>2 uncertainty ensemble unless declared later as a separate post-hoc analysis
no treating NOT_APPLICABLE reachability as a successful negative prediction

next_stage.name: One-replicate discovery, stability, falsification, and uncertainty smoke
next_stage.rule: Run one non-official performance smoke replicate per scenario. First validate selection/stability/null/uncertainty mechanics. Do not run official replicates and do not interpret smoke values scientifically.

prospective_multiclass_amendment.reason: Stage 8A froze model selection over k=2..6, while the inherited real-case severity thresholding and CIPHER uncertainty/reachability layer were binary. This mismatch was identified before any synthetic model-performance result. The amendment defines how k>2 selected solutions are evaluated without changing any previously frozen thresholds.

null_scenario_accounting.S4_SEVERITY_CONTINUUM: Any configurational_profile_claim=True is a false configurational claim, regardless of selected k.
null_scenario_accounting.S5_GOVERNANCE_CONFOUNDED: Any configurational_profile_claim=True is a false configurational claim, regardless of selected k.
null_scenario_accounting.S6_NO_CLUSTER_NULL: Any stable_partition_claim=True is a false stable-profile claim. A false robust-reachability claim can occur only when selected_k=2 and the binary reachability layer makes such a claim.
